script_full: Mara found a phone on the park bench just as it started to ring. She answered, and a man asked her to bring it to the bakery on Fifth Street. When she got there, the baker laughed and pointed at the oven. His son had been hiding phones around town all week as a game. Mara stayed for a free loaf of bread.
script_cut: Mara found a phone on the park bench just as it started to ring. She answered, and a man asked her to bring it to the bakery on Fifth Street.

script_full: The ferry to the island leaves at six. Tom arrived at five past, carrying a birthday cake for his grandmother. A fisherman offered him a ride in a small boat that smelled of bait. Halfway across, a wave soaked them both, and the cake box filled with water. His grandmother ate the wet cake anyway and said it was the best she'd had.
script_cut: The ferry to the island leaves at six. Tom arrived at five past, carrying a birthday cake for his grandmother. A fisherman offered him a ride in a small boat that smelled of bait.

script_full: On Monday the office coffee machine stopped working. By Tuesday, someone had taped a sign to it that read "Rest in peace." On Wednesday, Priya brought a screwdriver from home and opened the back panel. Inside she found a teaspoon, bent in half. Nobody admitted to it. The machine worked again, and the sign stayed up for a year.
script_cut: On Monday the office coffee machine stopped working. By Tuesday, someone had taped a sign to it that read "Rest in peace." On Wednesday, Priya brought a screwdriver from home and opened the back panel.

script_full: Two brothers decided to paint their mother's fence while she was away. They chose a bright green that had been on sale. When they finished, they noticed the neighbor watching from her porch. The fence, she told them, was hers. Their mother's fence was on the other side of the yard. They bought a second can and painted that one too.
script_cut: Two brothers decided to paint their mother's fence while she was away. They chose a bright green that had been on sale.

script_full: Every morning, an old man fed the pigeons outside the train station. One day he didn't come. The newspaper seller noticed, then the taxi drivers, then the woman who ran the flower stall. By noon they had found his address and knocked on his door. He opened it with a cast on his foot. From then on, they took turns feeding the pigeons for him.
script_cut: Every morning, an old man fed the pigeons outside the train station. One day he didn't come. The newspaper seller noticed, then the taxi drivers, then the woman who ran the flower stall.

script_full: Lena's car broke down on a country road, ten miles from the wedding where she was supposed to sing. A farmer stopped his tractor and offered her a lift. It took an hour. She arrived with straw in her hair as the guests were sitting down to eat. She sang anyway, and the farmer stayed for the dancing.
script_cut: Lena's car broke down on a country road, ten miles from the wedding where she was supposed to sing. A farmer stopped his tractor and offered her a lift.

script_full: The school's hamster escaped on the last day before the holidays. The children searched the cupboards, the bags and the teacher's coat pockets. Nobody found it. Two weeks later the caretaker opened the piano to tune it and found the hamster asleep on the felt, surrounded by stolen crayons. It had grown noticeably fatter.
script_cut: The school's hamster escaped on the last day before the holidays. The children searched the cupboards, the bags and the teacher's coat pockets.

script_full: A storm knocked out the power on the restaurant's busiest night. The cook lit every candle he could find and kept working on the gas stove. The waiters told each table the dark was a special event. People stayed for hours. The next month, the owner turned the lights off on purpose and charged extra.
script_cut: A storm knocked out the power on the restaurant's busiest night. The cook lit every candle he could find and kept working on the gas stove.

script_full: Sam ordered a small bookshelf online. Three weeks later, a truck delivered a crate the size of a refrigerator. Inside was a canoe. He called the company, and they told him to keep it. Sam had never been in a boat. That summer he learned to paddle on the lake, and he still keeps his books on the floor.
script_cut: Sam ordered a small bookshelf online. Three weeks later, a truck delivered a crate the size of a refrigerator. Inside was a canoe.

script_full: A girl on the bus noticed that the man beside her had left his umbrella behind. She jumped off at the next stop and ran back two blocks in the rain. She found him outside a bank and held it out. He looked puzzled. It wasn't his; he had found it on the seat himself. They stood under it together until the rain stopped.
script_cut: A girl on the bus noticed that the man beside her had left his umbrella behind. She jumped off at the next stop and ran back two blocks in the rain.

script_full: The town clock had been five minutes slow for as long as anyone could remember. Shops opened by it and trains were missed by it. Then a new mayor had it fixed. For a week, everyone was late for everything. People complained so much that the mayor climbed the tower himself and set it back.
script_cut: The town clock had been five minutes slow for as long as anyone could remember. Shops opened by it and trains were missed by it. Then a new mayor had it fixed.

script_full: Nina borrowed her roommate's bicycle without asking and rode it to the market. When she came out with her shopping, the bicycle was gone. She spent the afternoon looking for it and finally went home to confess. The bicycle was in the hallway. Her roommate had seen it at the market, assumed it had been stolen, and taken it back.
script_cut: Nina borrowed her roommate's bicycle without asking and rode it to the market. When she came out with her shopping, the bicycle was gone.

script_full: A boy entered his dog in the village pet show, in the category for best trick. The dog knew exactly one trick, which was to sit. On stage, the dog refused. It walked to the judges' table and ate a sandwich instead. The crowd cheered so loudly that the judges gave it first prize.
script_cut: A boy entered his dog in the village pet show, in the category for best trick. The dog knew exactly one trick, which was to sit.

script_full: Before dawn, a baker's apprentice put salt in the dough instead of sugar. Forty loaves were already in the oven when he realized. He expected to be fired. The baker tasted one, thought for a while, and put them in the window as "sailor's bread." They sold out by eight, and it has been on the menu ever since.
script_cut: Before dawn, a baker's apprentice put salt in the dough instead of sugar. Forty loaves were already in the oven when he realized.

script_full: Three friends went camping and discovered that each had assumed someone else would bring the tent. They had two sleeping bags, a guitar and a great deal of food. They built a shelter out of branches, and it collapsed at midnight. They gave up, lay in the open and watched the stars. All three caught a cold.
script_cut: Three friends went camping and discovered that each had assumed someone else would bring the tent. They had two sleeping bags, a guitar and a great deal of food.

script_full: I think people should stop giving birthday presents to adults. Nobody needs more things, and most gifts end up in a drawer. A card and a meal together would mean more and cost less.
Open offices are a mistake. I can hear every phone call around me, and I get half as much done as I did when I had a door. The money saved on walls is lost in wasted time.
Everyone should spend at least one summer in a job that serves the public. A restaurant, a shop, anything. You learn patience, and you never treat a waiter badly again.
I'd rather take the train than fly, even when it takes twice as long. You can walk around, see the country, and arrive in the middle of town. Flying is just waiting in different rooms.
Recipes are overrated. The best cooks I know never measure anything. They taste as they go. Following a recipe exactly teaches you to follow instructions, not to cook.
Everybody should have to perform in front of an audience once a year. A song, a speech, a magic trick. It keeps you humble, and it makes you kinder to people on stage.
I think small talk is underrated. People call it shallow, but it's how strangers decide to trust each other. Every good friendship I have started with a conversation about nothing.
Museums should be open late at night and closed in the morning. Nobody wants to look at paintings at nine a.m. Most people are free in the evening, and that's when the doors are locked.
The best vacations are the ones where you go back to the same place every year. You stop being a tourist. You know the baker, you have a favorite table, and you can finally relax.
I don't think children need organized activities every day after school. Being bored is useful. Some of my best ideas as a kid came from an afternoon with nothing to do.
